g.text: Dynamic view — recall investigation, from scope to signed notice
Phase 1 · Scope at a fixed watermark
unconfirmed claims; it is labelled and never merged
The officer checks the content against
Publication does not wait for finality,
but it is not presented as CONFIRMED.
Recall starts from an external decision, not from the platform.
The platform produces the scope and carries the signed notice;
it does not withdraw stock, and it does not decide who is at fault.
